findings.body: The added spec declares `_query` without using it. The supplied close run reports an ESLint error at this line, so the repository test command exits before tests run. Remove the unused parameter or use it.

findings.body: The `expired` case fabricates the same `UnauthorizedException` as the `invalid` case. The HTTP integration test covers a missing cookie but never sends an expired one to the running API. It therefore cannot catch a failure to treat an expired cookie as signed out on invite preview. Add an HTTP case using an expired session cookie.
findings.title: Not done: expired-session invite preview integration test

findings.body: This test simulates a disappearing account by mocking the transaction's `member.findUnique`. The HTTP integration test checks an account that was already incomplete, so it never exercises an account change between the initial lookup and the locked check. The required at-join recheck is consequently proved only by a mocked unit test. Add a database-backed join test that changes account state while the join waits for the lock.
